schema.name: tracks

fields.name: position_from
fields.comment: begin position of this track along the merged edge

fields.name: position_to
fields.comment: end position of this track along the merged edge

fields.name: direction
fields.comment: orientation relative to the merged edge (+1 same, -1 reversed)

fields.name: level
fields.comment: optional vertical level (e.g. tunnel/bridge stacking level)

fields.name: tags
fields.comment: semantic tags used for matching/filtering/aggregation, including tunnel and bridge

fields.name: properties
fields.comment: additional source attributes as key-value pairs*, e.g. operator and line

schema.comment: ordered source track references that build this edge

schema.name: tags
schema.comment: aggregated edge tags (after ignoring configured tags)

schema.name: src_id_node_from
schema.comment: optional source-system identifier of the start node

schema.name: src_id_node_to
schema.comment: optional source-system identifier of the end node
